responsibility: Implements constexpr-style constant evaluation support reused by the Rust frontend’s backend lowering. The file carries a Rust-adapted fork of GCC C++ constexpr machinery for checking literal types, recording constexpr function definitions, testing potential constant expressions, folding non-dependent initializers, and evaluating tree expressions in constant contexts, enabling Rust const items and const functions to be represented and folded through GCC trees.
same_name_distinction: Contains the substantial constexpr implementation adapted for the Rust backend, including constant-expression checking, constexpr call bookkeeping, evaluation helpers, and initializer folding. Unlike rust-constexpr.h, it is the large implementation body rather than the small public surface used by the rest of lowering.
